messages:
alex-sales: FYI POC with OrchidPay stalled. Their reranker throws a dimension error during local compare and they hit repeated 429s while seeding the index. Can we swarm?

Tess-ml: can you paste the error and which model they're calling?

alex-sales: error from their backend:
```
ValueError: compare() expected vector length 1024 but got 1536
POST /v1/embeddings -> 200 OK (model=embed-plus-1536)
/compare -> 400 {"message":"dimension mismatch"}
```

diego-eng: immediately sounds like model/version mismatch. Did they re-run embedding pipeline with a new default model? Also 429s suggest their bulk ingest pattern is tripping our rate limiter.

nora-se: another angle: are they storing raw vectors in their own index or using our managed Rerank API? If managed, we can check the index metadata (dim). If self-managed, they probably re-ingested with a new model.

alex-sales: they claim no code change. They are using our Node SDK via serverless lambdas.

ops-bot: rate_limit: 429 on /v1/embeddings/bulk; X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0; reset_in: 35s

Tess-ml: quick reproduction ask: please run a single-item embedding call and show response top-level fields. curl example to send: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-plus-1536","input":["test"]}' | jq .
```
Look for .model and .data[0].embedding | length

alex-sales: customer ran it and returned model: "embed-plus-1536" with embedding length 1536. Their existing index metadata shows dim=1024.

diego-eng: two straightforward remediations: 1) re-index with 1536 vectors (recommended), 2) pin SDK/model to embed-lite-1024 during the POC so incoming vectors match index. Option 2 is fastest.

nora-se: for the 429s: ask them to reduce batch size and concurrency. Common culprit: parallelizing many lambdas each sending big bulk requests. Suggest serializing or using batch_size=16 and concurrency <=4. Also implement exponential backoff on 429s.

alex-sales: they want to know impact: will using embed-lite-1024 vs embed-plus-1536 hurt rerank quality? Also security asked if embeddings stored on our side are encrypted and retained.

Tess-ml: quality: depends on dataset. For short queries, difference often small; for fine-grained semantic similarity larger models can help. Recommend running a 300-sample A/B test during POC: compute MRR/NDCG.

nora-se: security answer: yes, embeddings at rest are encrypted with customer-specific KMS keys for Dedicated/Private. For hosted, data retention defaults to 30 days for POC keys unless an enterprise retention policy is applied. We can add the specific retention & KMS note to their security questionnaire.

alex-sales: they also sent a short sec questionnaire asking about SOC2, encryption, and VPC options. Nora can you drop the canned answers?

nora-se: will paste minimal sec FAQ.

nora-se: sec FAQ snippet: 
- SOC2: Redwood is SOC2 Type II certified (report available under NDA).
- Encryption: TLS in transit; AES-256 at rest; enterprise keys via customer KMS (Dedicated/Private).
- Data residency: we can pin region for Dedicated/Private; hosted keys default to region tied to account.
- VPC/on-prem: supported for enterprise customers.

diego-eng: operational note: if they choose re-index we can run a one-off ingest job for them (infra team). If they want to pin model in SDK, here's a small node example: 
```js
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.KEY });
// force legacy model for POC
const res = await r.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-lite-1024', input: docs, batch_size: 16 });
```
also ensure their lambda cold starts don't spawn >4 concurrent requests.

billing: on quota bump: we can offer a temporary POC uplift (72h) and a one-time burst for indexing; need customer name + expected qps. Pricing note: embed-plus-1536 is 2.4x cost of embed-lite-1024; include this in the POC estimate.

alex-sales: sending Orion contact + expected qps via DM. They chose to pin model for now to unblock, then re-index later. Can we get infra to hold an index job on standby?

ops-bot: queued bulk re-index job (id: job-17741-r1). ETA 40m once triggered.

Tess-ml: follow-ups: 1) ask customer to run the curl check and post output, 2) drop model override into their SDK and test, 3) lower batch/concurrency and add backoff, 4) security answers sent.

alex-sales: customer confirmed pinning model fixed the dimension error and ingestion is smoother after throttling back concurrency. They will schedule the A/B and consider re-index later. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
